topic: Instantaneous Rate of Change and the Derivative

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Average Rate of Change
lecture_lines: Average rate is the slope of a secant line.
It measures change over an interval of time.
Think of speed over a distance. [Asset: secant_line_anim]
animations: Draw a secant line between (a, f(a)) and (a+h, f(a+h)). Place [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/car.png] at (a, f(a)). Label points and line.
Label the slope [f(a+h) - f(a)] / h using color #FFFFFF.
Highlight the points in color #FF00FF and the line in #00FFFF. Display [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speedometer.svg].

sections.title: The Conceptual Bridge: Shrinking the Interval
lecture_lines: What happens if the interval gets smaller?
The secant line approaches the tangent line.
As h nears zero, we find instantaneous rate. [Asset: shrinking_h_anim]
animations: Show points (a, f(a)) and (a+h, f(a+h)) on a curve. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Animate the point (a+h, f(a+h)) moving towards (a, f(a)).
Show the secant line flattening into a tangent line. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Formal Definition: The Derivative
lecture_lines: This is the formal definition of a derivative.
It is the limit of the difference quotient.
The slope at a single point. [Asset: limit_definition_anim]
It captures the instantaneous rate of change.
A precise measurement at one moment. [Asset: speedometer_anim]
animations: Display limit notation: lim as h goes to 0.
Show the fraction [f(a+h) - f(a)] / h beside the limit.
Highlight the resulting expression f'(a) in color #FFFF00.
Animate the shrinking interval h towards 0, representing speed with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speedometer.svg].
Show the transition from secant slope to f'(a).

sections.title: Application: Visualizing the Slope
lecture_lines: Observe the slope changing along the curve.
The derivative is the tangent line's slope.
This connects algebra to geometry. [Asset: tangent_slider_anim]
Like a drone measuring climb rate.
Instantaneous changes visualized in real time. [Asset: climb_rate_anim]
animations: Display a graph of a function with varying slopes.
Highlight tangent lines at different points in color #00FF00.
Show slope values change smoothly as a tangent point moves.
Simulate a drone [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drone.svg] measuring rate of climb along the curve.
Visualize instantaneous slope changes as the point travels.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Derivative is the tangent line's slope.
It measures the instantaneous rate of change.
It is the limit of average rate. [Asset: summary_chart_anim]
Average rate over an interval.
Derivative at a specific point. [Asset: comparison_infographic_anim]
animations: Summarize: Secant slope approaches tangent slope at a point.
Display f'(a) as the limit of the difference quotient.
Flash all key formula components in color #FFFFFF.
Contrast average rate over interval [a, a+h].
Contrast derivative at point a.
